review:
A gold-mine train game. Money symbols worth up to 15x land on reels 1 to 4 and get collected when a Collect or Super Collect lands on reel five. Train Money symbols carry much bigger prizes – up to 5,000x.

Land a Super Collect with a Train Money symbol and a golden train arrives with a random number of carts, each adding +1x to the multiplier. Three dynamite scatters lead to the bonus. Up to 20,000x, 96.5% RTP. A fun twist on reel-five collectors.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
